name: ISO/IEC 27018
full_name: ISO/IEC 27018:2025 Information security, cybersecurity and privacy protection - Guidelines for protection of personally identifiable information (PII) in public clouds acting as PII processors: HCG control set
issuing_body: Heights Consulting Group, structured on ISO/IEC 27018:2025 (ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 27)
notice: HCG control set based on ISO/IEC 27018:2025, third edition. Control numbers and titles are used for identification only; the standard's text is licensed by ISO and IEC and is not reproduced. Controls marked HCG are written by HCG for the standard's public cloud PII processor extended control set and do not carry its Annex A numbering. ISO/IEC 27018 is a code of practice assessed alongside an ISO/IEC 27001 information security management system.

sources.title: HCG ISO/IEC 27018 control set: descriptions, guidance, test points and PII processor extended controls

control_flags.type: clause for a control of the standard (official number and title), or hcg for an HCG-written control in the public cloud PII processor extended control areas.

scoring.summary: Percentage of applicable controls implemented, with partial implementation counting as half. ISO/IEC 27018 defines no score; this percentage is an HCG measure of readiness.

rules.summary: A control is implemented only when every HCG test point under it is met.

The control set applies where the organization provides a public cloud service and processes PII as a processor for its cloud service customers. Controls excluded in the ISO/IEC 27001 statement of applicability with justification are marked not applicable.
In the implementation score a partially implemented control counts as half. This is an HCG convention.

glossary.definition: The code of practice for protecting PII in public clouds acting as PII processors.
An organization that processes PII on behalf of, and on the instructions of, a PII controller.
The organization that uses the public cloud service and is usually the PII controller.
A subcontractor engaged by the PII processor to process customer PII.
